summary.result: Considering stable performance and effective removal of pollutant in wastewater, low maintenance, and cost-effectiveness, the up- and down-flow constructed wetland was thought to be an effective and feasible alternative in rural area.
summary.background: The feasibility of the up- and down-flow constructed wetland was examined fur rural wastewater treatment in Korea.
summary.method: The wetland process was effective in treating nutrient as well as organic pollutant.
